players.product: PECVD (Stack ONO, ACHM hard-mask) and ALD thin-film deposition tools for 3D NAND and advanced memory, plus hybrid-bonding tools

quarterly_data.quarter: Piotech results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (07-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Lu Guangquan (results briefing), citing SEMI: China mainland's 2025 thin-film deposition equipment market was about US$93 hundred million, with PECVD the largest type at about 33%, ALD about 11% and SACVD / HDPCVD / Flowable CVD about 6%; the product types Piotech covers make up about 50% of the market, a domestic market of about US$46.5 hundred million, and its 2025 revenue of RMB 65.19 hundred million is roughly 20% of that addressable domestic market; it aims to keep raising share on technology and product performance. Answering an investor, the company said it has not yet entered the supply chains of Micron or SK Hynix and is actively expanding in overseas markets.
quarterly_data.figure: about 20% of the addressable domestic thin-film deposition market (company estimate)

quarterly_data.quarter: Piotech results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (07-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Gross margin (results briefing): the company said the 2025 gross-margin decline came from a high share of revenue from new products and new processes - because demand was urgent, some of these tools were shipped before the company finished its internal testing, making customer validation costlier; in Q1 2026 those advanced products entered scaled volume production and gross margin recovered. Chairman Lu Guangquan said Piotech wins orders on product performance (average uptime above 90%, lowering customers' cost of ownership, and joint process development) rather than on price, and expects gross margin to be broadly stable from here.

quarterly_data.quarter: Piotech results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (07-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (results briefing): the company said overall capacity utilization is at a healthy level and matches the order book, supporting continued revenue growth; the Shanghai Lingang base, built and put into production in 2025, still has room to raise output, and until new capacity is built it will tap existing facilities through management optimisation. Chairman Lu Guangquan said the Shenyang and Shanghai bases meet current capacity needs.
